Commentary.Commentary: That's it from this game then! Action from the T20I World Cup continues on Sunday. Two games to follow. It is England taking on Scotland and then it is the big one, India against Australia. Until then, goodbye and take care!

Laura Wolvaardt says she's pleased with the win. Credits the bowlers for the way they bowled. Admits they would have loved to chase it a little quicker but it didn't not happen. Ends by saying she hopes they go through.

Nigar Sultana Joty says it was a struggle with the bat and they did not have enough runs on the board. Mentions the team is young and will learn and there are a lot of positives. Ends by thanking the support they got from the crowd.

Tazmin Brits, PLAYER OF THE MATCH, says she was looking to rotate strike and they did not want to lose wickets. Adds she keeps wanting more, it wasn't an easy wicket and she's happy with how she played. Ends by saying it means a lot to represent her country.

Bangladesh just didn't have enough runs on the board! They're bowlers actually were quite decent. Especially Fahima who was the pick. The fielding too let them down a little as it wasn't up to the mark. End of another poor show by Bangladesh.

An easy win for South Africa! 106 was never going to be a massive challenge and they have knocked it out with ease. A couple of partnerships is all they needed and they got that. Anneke Bosch and Tazmin Brits batted well and it is their stand which took them into a comfortable position. Chloe Tryon and Marizanne Kapp rnshred they get over the line.
